articles.summary: Additional Analyses from ACACIA-HCM Further Characterize Exercise Performance, Treatment Effect, Dose Titration and Safety of Aficamten in Non-Obstructive HCM SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Oct. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Cytokinetics, Incorporated (Nasdaq: CYTK) today announced that additional data from ACACIA-HCM ( A ssessment C omparing A ficamten to Placebo on C ardiac Endpoints I n A dults with Non-Obstructive HCM ) were presented at the Heart Failure Society of America (HFSA) Annual Scientific Meeting 2026 in Phoenix, AZ. “These additional analyses from ACACIA-HCM add to the body of evidence supporting the overall benefit-risk profile of aficamten in patients with nHCM,” said Stephen Heitner, M.D., Cytokinetics’ Chief Medical Officer. “The current CPET analysis demonstrates significant improvement in a clinically relevant and novel metric of global exercise performance, while additional data provide insights into dose titration and reinforce our confidence in the safety and
articles.title: Cytokinetics Announces Additional Data from ACACIA-HCM Presented at the HFSA Annual Scientific Meeting 2026
